summary: Flashback brings you an addictive mind game! Slide and find, solve the puzzle!
description:
Welcome to the unique world of Flashback! 

This game has been developed for you to challenge yourself, train your brain, and improve your thinking skills! This new game is an interesting and addictive game with an easy to understand, fun process!

If you are looking for a new and different game among hundreds of riddles games, you are in the right place and the game you are looking for is right here! Flashback is designed with brand new features for players who love brain puzzle games but seek innovation in the game!

Flashback offers a new time control gameplay while solving complicated riddles, unique puzzles and iq tests! Watch the scene, go back in time, find clues and complete the levels! Control the time and watch the animations!

A unique experience awaits you with riddles and brain teasers that will confuse and challenge you. Fabulous quality animations and original creative levels will challenge you to find the real answer. You won't be able to wait a moment to solve them all! 

This new game has a lot of tricky and challenging puzzles that will allow you to exercise your brain. Brain teasers and riddles allow you to brainstorm to determine the answer. If you want to improve your mind skills, you should play the game daily and test your brain with more difficult levels!

Flashback has multiple types of scenarios and puzzles to solve. This new riddle game gives you a chance to learn the truth behind the scenes, uncover mysterious scenarios and train your brain! Pick an option each round, improve your ability to reach conclusions by thinking differently. You can solve all the riddles and prove that you're the smartest people between all of your friends! 

Flashback is a combination of a variety of riddles, mind challenges, brain teasers, tricky puzzles, logical IQ tests, mind-blowing clues that will make you think critically.

When you get stuck in a hard riddle or the levels get tough, you have the chance to go back in time and watch the scene again! This logic game requires you to be a detective to find the answer! Just like a detective on the trail, you must find clues and move on to the next level. The faster you can find the hidden clues, the easier you can pass the levels! 

In this game, you will meet a lot of different characters and solve hundreds of puzzles. You will be able to train your brain and change the way you think. Flashback will develop your elaboration skills! 

Brain puzzles is a fun game for all ages and Flashback provides that for you. You can play this game with your friend, partner or kids and have a wonderful time together! 

Feature of the game: 

- Addictive gameplay
- Challenging clues to find
- Lots of different characters 
- Control the time! Slide and find!
- Hundreds of puzzles and iq tests
- Unique quality animations and drawings
- Brain training that develops thinking skills!

Tricky brain teasers and IQ tests guarantee that you will have a lot of fun playing this game and you will be addicted to Flashback!

Start a relentless challenge for yourself and your friends. Test your or a friend's IQ! Show your strength, prove your intelligence! Become the best riddle solver player!

Download the game now, share it with your friends! Crack the mystery!

Enjoy Flashback!
